name: @mpd-dsh/verify-plugin
description: The verification law (W4): code written by A is verified by a DIFFERENT agent B, from the documentation, with the verdict recorded before any implementation read. One row, five mpd_verify_* tools, a durable ledger under <workspace>/.mpd/verify/, a whitelisted gate runner, a content-free artifact probe and the record validator that makes the rule mechanical instead of aspirational.
